title: Figure 6: Unmanned military vehicles (Predator, Global Hawk, Fire Scout, Raven)
description: Collage of nine color images of unmanned systems. Caption reads "Figure 6. Examples of Unmanned Military vehicles: (left to right, top to bottom) Predator, Global Hawk, Fire Scout, Bell Eagle, BAE Mantis, rendering of an airwing of mixed UAVs, Tomahawk cruise missile, remote ground vehicles, and the Raven." The last image shows a soldier hand-launching a small Raven UAV.
